ItemDescription.Value:
[b]RETIRED — please unsubscribe.[/b]
This item used to hold ModReady's own build of Mod Configuration Menu v5. ModReady no longer ships its own copies of the BUTR dependency modules: BUTR's originals are updated for Bannerlord v1.4.8, and running two sets with the same module IDs was causing crashes.
[b]What to do:[/b] unsubscribe from this item and subscribe to BUTR's original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859238197]Mod Configuration Menu v5[/url]. Full BUTR stack: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859188632]Harmony[/url] · [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859222409]UIExtenderEx[/url] · [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859232415]ButterLib[/url] · [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859238197]Mod Configuration Menu v5[/url].
ModReady itself lives on as an optional add-on (save-load and crash guards) that runs on top of BUTR's stack: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/mountandblade2bannerlord/mods/11274]Nexus[/url] · [url=https://github.com/Trashpanda62/modready-framework]source[/url].

ChangeNotes.Value: Retired. ModReady no longer ships its own Harmony/UIExtenderEx/ButterLib/MCM. Unsubscribe and use BUTR's originals (linked in the description), which support v1.4.8.
